action.note: Core: action.idlv2 declares only setBadgeBackgroundColor/setBadgeText/setIcon; the native methods resolve but discard the values (no toolbar/action model, no click event). Toolbar UI is TODO on both platforms. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, web_extensions_porting.md 3.7]

alarms.note: Core: in-memory alarms (private/alarms.cpp). Not persisted across restarts (persistAcrossSessions reported but ignored); browser min-delay/throttling not enforced. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

browserAction.note: Legacy v1 IDL (browseraction.idl): onClicked listener placeholder only, never fired, and the service is not in the active runtime implementation list. New work should target the v2 action API. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

extension.note: Core (private/extension_api.cpp): identity, getURL, legacy sendRequest/onRequest routed through runtime messaging, access checks. inIncognitoContext/isAllowedIncognitoAccess reflect whether this runtime is the private world, not the extension's incognito grant. getViews/getBackgroundPage return conservative placeholders (live Window objects cannot cross the JSON bridge). [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

i18n.note: Core: getMessage/getUILanguage are injected JS over the extension's default_locale messages.json (substitutions, placeholders, @@ messages, escapeLt). No locale negotiation/fallback; getAcceptLanguages/getPreferredSystemLanguages always resolve ["en-US"] and detectLanguage an unreliable en-US result (stubs, not done). [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

menus.note: Core (private/context_menus_v2.cpp): validated menu model, CRUD, click/shown/hidden dispatch, Firefox overrideContext/refresh. Linux: GTK projects snapshots into WebKit page menus. Windows: context-menu host not attached (menus are drawn from C#), nothing is shown. Firefox getTargetElement/targetElementId need WebKit target-element tokens the public GTK API does not expose. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, web_extensions_porting.md 3.2]

notifications.note: Core (private/notifications.cpp) keeps records and delegates display to the host NotificationProvider. Windows: OrionBackend/notification_bridge + Services/NotificationService.cs (App SDK toasts). Linux: GTK registers no provider, so calls succeed but nothing is shown and no events fire. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, web_extensions_porting.md 3.8]

pageAction.note: Legacy v1 IDL (pageaction.idl): included in the runtime but only an onClicked placeholder that is never dispatched. New work should target the v2 action API. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

permissions.note: Core (private/permissions.cpp): getAll/contains derived from manifest permissions, host_permissions, content-script origins, Firefox data_collection. No optional-grant store, prompt or events. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

runtime.note: Core (private/runtime.cpp): identity/manifest/URL helpers, local + cross-extension messaging, ports with startup replay, reload. Not done: lifecycle/update/platform/context/package/browser-info members are generated rejection stubs, their events are declared but never emitted, and native messaging (connectNative/sendNativeMessage) is rejected — it needs a per-OS host registry. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

scripting.note: Core: full Chrome/Firefox facade on the v2 bridge, but the native class (private/scripting_v2.cpp) is an empty harness: every operation is a generated rejection stub. Content-script injection is not implemented on any platform. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md, web_extensions_porting.md 3.5]

storage.note: Core: all four areas DB-backed (private/storage.cpp): get/getKeys/getBytesInUse/set/remove/clear/setAccessLevel + scoped onChanged, quotas, access levels. sync is a separate local namespace (no cross-device sync); managed is read-only with no policy source; session is a :memory: DB. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

tabs.note: develop: only getCurrent + query (queryInfo ignored, always the active tab; no events). aki/tabs-core rewrites tabs on the core tab DB with a shadow index: get/query filters/create/duplicate/update/move/remove/reload/goBack/goForward/sendMessage/connect/getSelected/getAllInWindow/capture* and the lifecycle events. Windows host pieces (tab-id trio, reload/back/forward) are on aki/profile-process; Linux already supplies the tab-id trio in GTK. Items marked In Progress = implemented on those unmerged branches; captureTab/captureVisibleTab additionally lack a Windows tabs_capture. TAB_ID_NONE/SPLIT_VIEW_ID_NONE are declared JS constants with no shim registered. Everything else declared in tabs.idlv2 is a generated rejection stub or a never-emitted event. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md + branch survey]

webNavigation.note: Core (private/webnavigation_v2.cpp): facade + listener registration only. getFrame resolves undefined, getAllFrames []; no navigation events are dispatched (needs the WebKit frame/document lifecycle from the host). [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

webRequest.note: Core (private/webrequest_v2.cpp): generated event objects retain listener registrations and filters, but the network stack never dispatches requests; blocking responses cannot modify traffic. Only onBeforeRequest/onBeforeSendHeaders/onCompleted have detailed schemas. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md]

windows.note: develop: getCurrent returns a synthetic minimal window; everything else is a rejection stub, no events. aki/tabs-core: get/getCurrent/getLastFocused/getAll from the core window DB + onCreated/onRemoved/onFocusChanged (via ProfilesChange). Items marked In Progress = implemented on that unmerged branch. create/update/remove (and CreateType) are still generated rejection stubs; onBoundsChanged is never emitted. [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md + branch survey]

alarms.clearAll.note: Returns true even when the extension had no alarms.

alarms.create.note: persistAcrossSessions accepted but nothing is persisted.

extension.getBackgroundPage.note: Placeholder: current window under service-worker emulation only.

extension.getViews.note: Placeholder: returns only the caller's own window.

i18n.getUILanguage.note: Returns the extension default_locale, not Orion's UI locale.

menus.ContextType.note: GTK only projects page (WebKit) context menus; the toolbar/tab/bookmark/password/tools_menu contexts are not shown.

menus.OnClickData.frameId.note: GTK hit test has no frame identity; top frame is reported.

menus.create.command.note: GTK: command items dispatch onClicked but the command is not executed.

menus.create.icons.note: GTK projection does not expose item icons.

menus.refresh.note: GTK: accepted, but cannot redraw an already-open native menu.

notifications.NotificationOptions.requir.note: Windows: maps to a long toast duration (Reminder scenario only with buttons).

notifications.onClosed.note: Windows reports no dismissal without a click (swipe-away never fires onClosed); activation counts as byUser=true.

permissions.request.note: No prompt/grant store: true only for already-active permissions, otherwise false.

runtime.MessageSender.note: Sender objects carry only id/url/origin; tab/frame/document/TLS fields are missing.

storage.managed.note: Read-only (set/remove/clear reject, as in browsers) and always empty: no enterprise policy provider.

storage.sync.note: Local-only namespace with sync quotas/rate limits; no remote synchronization backend.

tabs.getCurrent.note: develop: id + url only; the Windows host answers "unknown tab id" until aki/profile-process lands.

tabs.query.note: develop: queryInfo ignored, resolves the active tab of the calling view / selected window.

windows.getCurrent.note: develop: synthetic window (ignores queryOptions, no tabs, hard-coded focus/state/type/incognito). Core-DB-backed on aki/tabs-core.
